## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND give mixed confirmations supporting the NEUTRAL call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit and volatility neutral: HYG (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +1.04%) ABOVE TREND show little stress while VXX (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%) ↓ falling dampens immediate fear.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive: TLT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND points to firmer bond demand while TIP (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -0.04%) RECOVERY suggests real-rate pressures are mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Mixed leadership: XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%) ABOVE TREND and XLI (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while XLK (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) BELOW TREND and XLY (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND lag; style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US internals mixed: SPY (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND but IWM (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) ABOVE TREND; EM soft with EEM (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Muted speculative flows: IBIT (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) BELOW TREND and ETHA (1W: -10.18% | 1M: -24.84%) BELOW TREND show risk-off in crypto, while MTUM (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +8.16%) ABOVE TREND signals momentum exposures still gathering traction.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Metals weak: CPER (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND; natural gas strength with UNG (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy is soft: XLE (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%) BELOW TREND, while selective commodity pockets (UNG ABOVE TREND) outperform.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed pockets: XBI and SOXX ABOVE TREND confirm sector-level cyclicals; major divergence exists as SPY and XLK are BELOW TREND while IWM and TLT are ABOVE TREND, so suppress strong regime tilts.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to high-momentum/cyclicals like XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%) ABOVE TREND, reduce exposure to China FXI (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND and crypto IBIT (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) BELOW TREND, and monitor bond strength in TLT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Biotech XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, Semis SOXX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials XLI (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: China FXI (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) BELOW TREND, Silver SLV (1W: -13.61% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND, Uranium URA (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -13.65%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND; BEARISH: Copper CPER (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND, broad oil ETFs USO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -20.21%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
Watch VXX 20 as a complacency/panic pivot with VXX (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND; watch HYG/LQD spread (HYG 1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.14% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: +0.67% | 1M: +1.04% ABOVE TREND) for credit stress; watch XLK/XLF cross (XLK 1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19% BELOW TREND; XLF 1W: -0.27% | 1M: +4.01% CORRECTION) for style rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with mixed signals from volatility and bond/stock ratios supporting a restrained stance. XBI (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: divergence between SPY (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) ABOVE TREND that could quickly tilt the regime.
